# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Pidgeon has a mustache that he is known to twirl.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Pidgeon is prone to sarcasm and mocking remarks toward his students, often making them stand on the dais before the blackboard as punishment. He tends to ignore the younger children while spending most of his effort on the older pupils preparing for Regent's entrance exams. He is easily distracted during lessons by his romantic feelings, often spending time scribbling messages or helping older female students with their coursework.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

- sarcastic and mocking toward pupils  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>

- strict and stern disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- dramatic recitation and speechmaking  <sub>[v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- verse writing  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>

## Goals

- court Sukey Pullen and assist her with coursework  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010)</sub>
- prepare older students for the Regent's Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, where he lodged at the home of Eben Duckett and secured his position due to his uncle being a school trustee. During his tenure, he spent much of his time pursuing Sukey Pullen, courting her at the back bench and writing verse to her. After Hugh Carrow joined the fourth class and teased Nell Harcourt, Pidgeon disciplined Nell by writing a public scolding on the blackboard and making her stand before the class, and on another occasion forced her to sit beside Hugh, leading Nell to boycott school temporarily. Pidgeon also participated in local events, delivering a recitation of Mark Antony's address at the Brierley Debating Club concert. At the end of the school year, Pidgeon delivered an emotional parting speech to the pupils and departed his position, leaving Brierley to be succeeded by Miss Agnes Thorne.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)_
